Design Leader, Experience Transformation

We are early in our design maturity journey and need a design leader to elevate design's standing across the enterprise. Design currently reports through program management and has no dedicated budget; this role exists to change that by demonstrating design's value.

Responsibilities:
- Evangelize human-centered design across business units that have not historically engaged with design.
- Influence senior stakeholders to invest in design; build the business case for design headcount, one win at a time.
- Drive adoption of design methods through workshops, roadshows, and change-management programs.
- Champion design in executive forums; prove ROI through pilots and convert skeptical partners into sponsors.
- Elevate design maturity across the organization through education and advocacy programs.
- Partner with transformation offices on workforce change initiatives.

About you:
- A persuasive communicator who thrives on building buy-in and winning hearts and minds.
- Comfortable operating without an established team; you will borrow resources from vendor partners while making the case for permanent staff.
- Resilient in the face of skepticism; you see resistance as an opportunity.

Hybrid; travel to business-unit sites approximately 40%.
